searchText: Sigh. Mirroring to IPFS or such is a good idea though. If Discord goes bankrupt the entire public record of our deliberations goes with it. Even Google Groups might be better - I think it still feeds into the usenet network. But we seem to prefer walled gardens.

excerpts.author: gcolvin
